market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are a firmly mid‑table Premier League side with strong financial backing and a deep squad. Historical data shows clubs of their profile get relegated less than 5% of the time per season. An implied probability of 34.5% is dramatically higher than any realistic assessment, making 'No' (market overprices Yes) a high‑confidence opportunity.
evidence_points: West Ham have finished between 6th and 16th in each of the last 10 seasons, never being relegated.
Bookmaker relegation odds for West Ham at the start of the 2024‑25 season were around 8–10% and they have remained safe.
The three promoted sides plus perennial strugglers account for the vast majority of relegations historically, leaving limited probability for a club of West Ham’s stature.
sources_consulted: Bookmaker pre‑season relegation odds (Bet365, William Hill)
Squad financial metrics (Deloitte Football Money League)
